title: ADR Body Immutability, Status Mutability, and Supersession Workflow
summary: ADRs are the historical record and current-state artifacts carry currency; an accepted ADR's body is immutable while its status and a dated supersession or update header are mutable; a four-step supersession workflow and a drift-resolution decision tree govern changes. Since ADR-099 the immutable body of a post-ADR-099 unit is its Substrate record and the markdown file is derived.

supersession.text: For governance units authored after ADR-099 (§Authority option C), the immutable body is the Substrate record; the markdown ADR file is a derived Surface View. Legacy units (ADRs 001 through 098) remain canonical in their files.

links.note: for units authored after ADR-099 the immutable body is the Substrate record; legacy units 001–098 stay canonical in their files; nested sub-decision status defined
